meta.title: Visa Master
meta.description: Prepare clearer, more consistent visa documents.

footer.disclaimer: We do not apply on your behalf, and we do not influence the consulate’s decision.

languageSwitcher.note: Switches the interface language only. The language of your document pack is set by the destination country’s requirements.

landing.intro: Prepare clearer, more consistent visa documents.
landing.cta: Sign in or create an account

route.title: Let us check whether we can help yet
route.intro: Four questions first. A combination we do not serve never creates an application, and never charges you.
route.areaLabel: Which province or municipality do you live in?
route.areaHint: A visa is handled by the consulate covering where you live, so this decides where the application is submitted.
route.destinationLabel: Which country are you going to?
route.purposeLabel: What is the main purpose of this trip?
route.employmentLabel: What is the applicant’s current work situation?

supported.title: We can prepare this route now
supported.body: A resident of the Chengdu consular district, going to Spain on a personal tourism visa, in employment. Next you fill in the application. You can leave at any point and your answers are kept.

unsupported.title: We cannot prepare this route yet
unsupported.intro: For now we serve residents of the Chengdu consular district applying for a Spanish personal tourism visa, where the applicant is employed. In your case:

reason.area: You do not live in the area the Chengdu consulate covers.
reason.purpose: The purpose is not personal tourism.
reason.employment: The applicant is not in employment.

unsupported.waitlistTitle: Tell us you needed this one
unsupported.waitlistBody: Demand decides which route opens next. The record holds only the place you live and the destination you chose.
unsupported.waitlistDone: Recorded. We will email you if this route opens.

route.createFailed: The application was not created. Try again.
route.sessionExpired: Your sign-in is no longer valid. Sign in again and your answers will still be here.
route.waitlistFailed: That was not recorded. Try again.

jobStatus.validating: Checking the documents against each other
jobStatus.awaiting_input: We need something more from you

application.asyncNote: Preparing the documents takes about 10 minutes. You can close this page — we will tell you when the state changes.
application.notStartedNote: No machine is consuming the queue yet, so this application stays in the queue. That is expected while running locally.

login.title: Sign in or create an account
login.intro: Enter your email address and we’ll send you a 6-digit code.

otp.title: Enter your code
otp.failed: That code is not correct or has expired. Enter it again, or send a new one.
otp.rateLimited: A code was sent a moment ago. Wait a moment and try again.
otp.sendFailed: We could not send the code. Try again.
otp.checkFailed: We cannot check that code right now. Try again in a moment.

auth.notConfigured: Sign-in is not available yet: the authentication service has not been configured.
auth.signOutFailed: Signing out did not complete. Close your browser, or try again in a moment.

empty.title: You do not have any applications yet
empty.body: Applications you create will appear here.

loadFailed.title: We cannot load your applications right now
loadFailed.body: This does not mean they are gone. Refresh the page and try again; if it keeps happening, tell us.

errorSummary.title: There is something to fix before you continue

notFound.title: This page cannot be found
notFound.body: This address does not exist, or it has moved.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong
unexpected.body: That did not complete. Refresh the page and try again.

validation.invalid: Check this entry and enter it again.

otp.invalidFormat: Your code is 6 digits. Check it and enter it again.

validation.tooShort: {min, plural, one {Enter at least # character.} other {Enter at least # characters.}}
validation.tooLong: {max, plural, one {Enter no more than # character.} other {Enter no more than # characters.}}

date.future: This date cannot be later than today.
date.past: This date cannot be earlier than today.

pinyin.invalid: Use the Latin spelling from the passport in this field.

number.invalid: A passport number is {length} characters. Copy it from the passport and enter it again.

expiry.beforeIssue: The expiry date cannot be earlier than the issue date. Check both dates.
expiry.tooSoon: This passport has less than {monthsRequired} months left. Renew it first, then come back and prepare the documents.
expiry.tooSoonForTrip: Counting from the return date, this passport has less than {monthsRequired} months left. Renew it first.

amount.invalid: Enter the amount as digits, for example 12000.

travel.returnBeforeDeparture: The return date cannot be earlier than the departure date. Check both dates.

intake.hubIntro: It comes in sections and you can stop at any point. Each answer is saved as you give it, and signing in again brings you back to where you stopped.
intake.saved: Saved. You can close this page at any time and carry on later.
intake.saveFailed: That answer was not saved. Try again.
intake.unavailableHint: We have not built this section yet. Everything you have answered is saved.

section.companions: Who you travel with, and who pays

applicant.name: What is the applicant’s name in Chinese?
applicant.nameHint: Write it as it appears on their identity card.
applicant.pinyin: How is the name written on the passport?
applicant.pinyinHint: Copy the spelling from the passport’s data page, spaces and all. Every document uses this spelling.
applicant.birthDate: What is the applicant’s date of birth?
applicant.phone: Which mobile number should we use?
applicant.phoneHint: We use it when the documents are ready, or if something is missing.

passport.numberHint: Top right of the passport’s data page. It is 9 characters.
passport.expiresAtHint: Schengen rules ask for at least 3 months of validity after you leave the Schengen area.

residence.city: Which city does the applicant live in?
residence.cityHint: Where they actually live: this is what decides which consulate handles the application.
residence.addressHint: Down to the building and unit number. The application form asks for the full address.

employment.employer: What is the full name of the applicant’s employer?
employment.employerHint: As it appears on the business licence and social-insurance records. The employment letter uses this name.
employment.startDate: When did they start this job?
employment.startDateHint: How long they have worked there goes into the employment letter.
employment.monthlyIncome: What is their monthly salary before tax?
employment.monthlyIncomeHint: In yuan, digits only. This figure has to match the bank statements.

travel.departureDate: When do they plan to leave?
travel.departureDateHint: An estimate is fine if nothing is booked yet. You can change it later.
travel.returnDate: When do they plan to come back?
travel.cities: Which cities are they going to?
travel.citiesHint: In the order they will visit them, separated by commas — for example: Madrid, Seville, Barcelona. The itinerary follows this order.

companions.whoPays: Who is paying for this trip?
companions.whoPaysHint: If somebody else is paying, that person’s proof of funds is needed as well.

history.schengenBefore: Have they been to a Schengen country before?
history.schengenBeforeHint: If they have, the earlier visas count as travel history.
history.refused: Has a visa application of theirs ever been refused?
history.refusedHint: Answer honestly. A refusal has to be declared on the form, and hiding one counts against the application more than the refusal itself.

review.title: Check and send
review.intro: Once you send this we start checking the official requirements and preparing the documents. It takes about 10 minutes and you can close the page.
review.incompleteTitle: There is still something to fill in
review.incompleteBody: These need attention before the application can be sent.
review.submitFailed: That was not sent. Try again.
review.alreadySubmitted: This application has already been sent.
review.documentsMissing: Some required documents have not been uploaded. Add them before sending.

documents.title: Upload your documents
documents.intro: Photograph them or pick a file — either is fine. Each one says what it is for: these are checked against what you told us.
documents.addCta: Choose a file or take a photo
documents.uploadFailed: That file was not sent. Try again.
documents.confirmFailed: The file went up, but we have not confirmed it. Refresh the page to check.
documents.tooLarge: That file is over 20 MB. Compress it, or photograph it a page at a time.
documents.wrongType: We accept JPG, PNG, HEIC and PDF.
documents.statusNote: We check only that a file opens and is legible. Whether it satisfies the consulate is decided by the person who reviews it.
documents.doneCta: Everything is here — send the application

item.passportBioWhy: The visa goes into this passport, and this page decides every identity field on the form. Photograph it so the number and the two machine-readable lines are sharp.
item.photoWhy: Schengen sets the size and background colour, and rejects photos that miss them. Use one taken by a photo shop rather than a cropped snapshot.
item.hukouWhy: It evidences residence and family relationships. The head-of-household page and the applicant's own page at a minimum.
item.employmentLetterWhy: It shows there is a job to come back to. The employer name and job title on it have to match what you entered.
item.bankStatementWhy: They show the trip can be paid for. Usually six months, stamped by the bank, with salary arriving in amounts that match what you entered.
item.socialInsuranceWhy: Not required, but it evidences how long the job has lasted independently of the employment letter, and the two support each other.
item.insuranceWhy: Schengen asks for at least €30,000 of cover, across every date of the trip.
item.flightBookingWhy: It evidences a real itinerary. A booking is enough — do not buy the ticket first.
item.hotelBookingWhy: They have to cover every night inside the Schengen area, with no gaps.
item.sponsorProof: Proof of funds from whoever is paying
item.sponsorProofWhy: When somebody else pays, the money has to be evidenced too — usually their bank statements and a short letter.
item.previousVisas: Earlier Schengen visas and entry stamps
item.previousVisasWhy: A good travel record helps an application. Photograph the old visa pages and the stamps that go with them.
